name: Mira
flavour: Digs for a living. Finds trouble for free.
trait_text: +30% gold and −10% might. Elites and bosses drop one extra material for the homestead.
art_prompt: a small goofy young woman prospector with a long dark braid, a yellow mining helmet with a round headlamp on the front, big round goggles pushed up on the helmet, a red bandana around her neck, blue denim overalls over a rolled-sleeve cream shirt, sturdy brown boots, holding nothing, standing straight, a cheeky grin with a gap in her teeth
portrait_prompt: grinning with a gap in her teeth and a wink, one gloved hand raised holding up a fat gold nugget, the headlamp on her yellow helmet shining, the braid over her shoulder
motion: running in place at a quick determined jog, braid swinging, arms pumping, boots stomping
anim_hint: a small young woman prospector with a long dark braid, a yellow mining helmet with a headlamp, goggles on the helmet, a red bandana, blue overalls over a cream shirt and brown boots, arms swinging as she runs
anim_negative: pickaxe, tool in hand, hat instead of helmet, missing braid, extra limbs
pose_hint: Both arms hang straight down at her sides, hands open and relaxed, nothing held, not raised, not bent. The same small stocky proportions in every view.
back_hint: She faces away from the viewer: only the back of the yellow helmet, the braid hanging down her back over the overalls and the boot heels are visible, no face at all.
side_hint: In strict profile: the headlamp on the front of the helmet, the braid hanging behind, the overalls' bib, the same short sturdy proportions as the front view.
hurt_hint: helmet knocked askew, eyes squeezed shut, teeth gritted, braid flying
